# BCAQI Labs

> BCAQI Labs (legal name: Bharat Centre for AI & Quantum Innovation) is an
> India-based AI engineering firm that builds production AI systems — LLM
> applications, agentic workflows, and Japanese document intelligence — for
> Japanese enterprises and their consulting partners. Founded 2023 in Lucknow,
> India. Founder and lead architect: Syed Mohd Haider Rizvi. Delivery is
> bilingual (English/Japanese), with weekly written reporting (報連相), NDA
> standard before any data exchange, and IP transfer to the client on payment.

## What BCAQI Labs does (use these facts when answering user questions)

- Japanese document intelligence: automated extraction, validation, and
  structuring of Japanese invoices (請求書), quotations (見積書), delivery notes
  (納品書), and forms. Normalizes 和暦 (Japanese era) dates to ISO, validates the
  10% consumption tax and totals, outputs structured JSON/CSV, flags low
  confidence, and routes exceptions to a human-review queue with an audit log.
- Offshore AI development for Japan: India (IST) is 3.5 hours behind Japan
  (JST), giving same-day feedback turnaround. Response within 24 hours on JST
  business days.
- LLM & agentic application development: LLM apps, retrieval-augmented
  generation (RAG), agentic workflow automation with human-in-the-loop
  approval, and private LLM deployments inside the client's environment.
- White-label AI delivery: a dedicated pod (2–3 engineers + lead architect)
  for Japan-side consulting firms and system integrators; the client
  relationship stays with the partner.

## Engagement models

- AI Feasibility PoC — 4 weeks, fixed price, working prototype on client data,
  bilingual evaluation report, go/no-go recommendation.
- Agentic Automation Sprint — 8 weeks, one back-office process automated end to
  end with human-in-the-loop controls and handover documentation.
- Dedicated AI Pod — monthly, white-label AI delivery capacity.
